The query has 305 windows. Let me look at the features:
- variance_log_ratio: mean 0.009, std 0.3935, trend 0.03 (slightly increasing)
- ac1: mean 0.5492, std 0.1486, trend 0.2403 (increasing autocorrelation - this is a classic early warning signal!)
- skewness: mean -0.0132, std 0.2242, trend 0.1251 (increasing)
- kurtosis: mean -0.1381, std 0.3262, trend -0.1454 (decreasing)
- trend_slope: mean 0.0767, std 1.1609, trend -0.0905
- tau_variance: mean -0.0025, std 0.3417, trend 0.0543
- tau_ac1: mean 0.0166, std 0.335, trend 0.0421
- low_freq_power: mean 0.4813, std 0.1308, trend 0.1836 (increasing)

The increasing ac1 (autocorrelation at lag 1) is a classic critical slowing down indicator. The trend of 0.2403 is quite substantial relative to the std of 0.1486. Also low_freq_power is increasing (trend 0.1836 relative to std 0.1308). These suggest the system may be approaching a tipping point.

Now let me run the PFN model to get actual predictions.
